notes: Standard statics from 5 user references (2026-10-29), nurse and travel (Europe + Disney) angles. Top: a white rounded pill with heavy dark all-caps "SOLUTION", under it dark text "ComfortWear" and "Ortho Stretch Cushion Shoes". Center: a pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference, large and sharp at true proportions, soft shadow. Under them, dark text on three lines: "Arch support and cushion made to last 12-hour shifts on hard hospital floors." concepts.headline: Things I wish I already knew about ComfortWear
concepts.prompt: Background: a softly blurred real photo of a hospital hallway with a nurse in navy scrubs walking away. In front, a large white rounded phone notes-app card (generic notes app, no real app logos) with a small yellow "< All Notes" at the top-left and share/more icons at the top-right. Bold black title on THREE lines "Things I wish" / "I already knew about" / "ComfortWear", sized so every line sits fully INSIDE the white card with a clear margin (at least 5% of the card width) on both sides; no letter may touch or cross the card edge. Then a list, each line with a yellow check-circle icon and black text: "Made for 3 12s in a row" / "Slip-resistant on wet floors" / "Wide toe box for feet that swell" / "Arch support that doesn't go flat" / "HSA/FSA eligible" / "30 days to try, or your money back". Bottom of the card: a pair of the black-and-purple shoes from the product reference, large and sharp at true proportions. Overlapping the card's lower-right edge, a round red badge with white "TODAY" and big white "40% OFF". All text is large, bold and high contrast for readers aged 60+; nothing small or thin. Compared with the second attached image: identical card, list, shoe, badge and background; only the title is re-set on three lines so it fits completely inside the card.
